sourceRef.section: CRAFTING, CRAFTING QUALITIES, CRAFTING FLAWS, REPAIRING EQUIPMENT, CRAFTING EXAMPLE, Artificer Formulae and Permanent Crafting

description: Crafting and enchanting share one successful-check, excess-success, Surge and Blunder resolution. New-item crafts produce the base item; successful enchanting applies a declared compatible ordinary enchantment to existing equipment. Excess successes purchase and rank permanent Qualities, one Skill Check Surge can unlock an exceptional Quality, and Blunders deteriorate one randomly selected reducible item statistic to a defined floor. Repairs restore defects; Points never decrease because of Flaws.

steps: Select the base item or existing owned item and a declared crafting/improvement/enchanting project.
Verify the appropriate materials, facilities, recipe and Company project opportunity.
Choose an appropriate Characteristic + Craft/Mysticism and Difficulty (1-5, normally 2-5 for enchantments).
Roll Characteristic D6; count dice meeting the Skill threshold as successes; Skill Checks produce at most one Surge and one Blunder.
Meeting Difficulty crafts the base item or applies a declared compatible ordinary enchantment to the existing item, at its printed Points.
Spend excess successes = max(0, successes - Difficulty) once each on ordinary ranked Qualities or further ranks of an unlocked exceptional Quality.
A successful Surge permits one exceptional Quality, subject to its required excess successes, compatibility and available capacity.

A Blunder deteriorates one uniformly random eligible reducible item statistic by one step (or causes material/tool loss on failed new-item crafting); record a repairable defect separately from purchased Points.

craftingDifficulty.description: Unlike Skill-scaled Commands, crafting is a task with an explicit Difficulty representing the complexity of the work.

levels.typicalEquipment: Martial weapons, bows, shields, Light Armor
Heavy weapons, firearms, mechanical equipment, Medium Armor
Heavy Armor, intricate machinery, minor magical equipment
Major magical equipment, advanced constructs, exceptional enchantments

notes: Unique relics and unusual materials can require narrative prerequisites; ordinary legal crafting does not require per-project GM approval.
Enchantment Difficulty is normally 2–5 based on complexity, materials and effect.

craftingChecks.defaultSkill: Craft, paired with whichever Characteristic best represents the work being performed.
notes: Each non-combat Skill Check generates at most one Surge and one Blunder; either can appear on a successful or failed check.
For ordinary campaign work, project eligibility, facilities and materials are checked automatically when supported; the GM sets exceptions, not routine approval.

success.rule: At or above Difficulty, craft the base item at its normal Points or apply the predeclared compatible ordinary enchantment to an existing item. There are no free extra improvements for merely meeting Difficulty.
success.excessSuccesses: max(0, total successes - Difficulty); these purchase normal qualities, ranks, or the required budget of an unlocked exceptional quality. Each excess success can be spent only once.

craftingResults.surge: At most one successful Skill-Check Surge unlocks one compatible exceptional Quality (for example Exceptional Edge granting Critical 1 on COMBAT Surges). Excess successes may improve its rank, respecting normal caps. It is not an additional ordinary quality point. A failed-check Surge may conserve materials or provide narrative information, never a permanent item bonus.
craftingResults.blunder: At most one Skill-Check Blunder uniformly chooses one eligible reducible stat field and deteriorates it by one step, after success/improvement effects; never beyond a floor. A failed enchantment or improvement can damage an existing item; a failed new-item craft loses materials/damages tools instead. The defect is repairable and does not lower Point cost.
craftingResults.both: A successful roll may generate both Surge and Blunder; apply improvements and deterioration independently.

craftingQualities.description: Successful basic crafts make a base item. Excess successes purchase ordinary Qualities and ranks. A Skill-Check Surge permits one exceptional Quality, which may be ranked up with excess successes under its own rules.

commonQualities.name: Sheltering
commonQualities.effect: Cover +1 against eligible ranged Attacks; grant normal Evade eligibility
commonQualities.eligible: Light/Medium Armor or explicitly qualified protective armor; Heavy Armor requires an exception

notes: Ranked Qualities use shared caps across crafted and enchanted sources on one item; each rank adds its normal battlefield Points.
No more than three distinct permanent named Qualities and one Surge-exclusive Quality on an ordinary item; a rank increase is not a new named Quality.
Cover X permits Evade against eligible ranged attacks even without terrain cover, and rerolls up to X natural ones. It does not help Charge Impact or effects disallowing Evade.
Item-specific compatibility and characteristic floors apply.
Destructive and Exceptional Edge are Surge-exclusive, not available from ordinary excess successes.
craftingQualities.pointsFormula: Base Equipment Points + total added ranks of Crafting Qualities + permanent Enchantment Points; defective ranks retain their purchased Points while awaiting repair.
craftingQualities.pointsFormulaNote: Improvement budgets are not Gold or XP. All permanent modifiers count at their listed battlefield Points; do not pay twice for one same-named shared rank.

surgeExclusive.name: Arcane Backlash
surgeExclusive.effect: Conditional Direct Damage 1 with defined trigger

craftingFlaws.description: The Blunder is mechanically resolved as one random eligible and reducible equipment statistic, with a recorded repairable deterioration step. It is never a character Characteristic loss, and never discounts battlefield Points.
craftingFlaws.selection: List the item's eligible and currently reducible STATISTIC FIELDS (one entry per field, not per available rank) and choose uniformly at random. If none, assign Damaged: no further improvement until repaired.

stats.change: worsen one step; after 6+ becomes inactive

exceptions: Weapon Damage 1 never becomes Damage 0 through a Blunder.
Do not deteriorate a normal Engaged weapon's nonexistent numerical Range.
Do not weaken a character's innate Characteristics, class Wounds or other non-item stats.
Failed NEW-item crafting creates no usable equipment, so its Blunder wastes materials or tools; failed work on EXISTING items can deteriorate the item.
Defects are reversible and do not reduce the equipment's printed or previously purchased battlefield Points.

rules: Repair requires normal materials, tools and Craft (or Mysticism for a magical defect), generally at the item's original project Difficulty.
A successful repair restores one eligible deterioration step or clears Damaged; choose one defect when several exist.
Repair never grants new Qualities or changes the printed purchased Points.
An unsuccessful repair Blunder can randomly deteriorate another eligible item statistic, subject to its usual floors.

craftingExample.description: Body 5 / Craft 4+ warrior attempts a Difficulty 2 Longsword (10 Points, Engaged / A4 / Hit 5+ / D1) and rolls [1,4,5,6,6]: four successes, two excess successes and one Skill-Check Surge, no Blunder.
resolution: Surge unlocks Exceptional Edge Critical 1: +30 Points; Critical activates only on subsequent COMBAT Attack Surges.
Spend one excess success to rank up to Critical 2: +15 Points.
Spend the other excess success to gain Balanced 1 (Accurate 1): +10 Points.
Final profile Engaged / A4 / Hit 5+ / D1, Accurate 1, Critical 2. Total 65 Points.

result.name: Exceptional Longsword
result.note: Printed/passive Critical converts failed dice per later COMBAT Surge; paid equipment Points remain unchanged if a future Blunder deteriorates the item.

artificerFormulaeNote: Artificer Formulas provide temporary effects via CP, not automatic permanent crafting. Permanent projects use ordinary Craft/Mysticism, ranked excess successes, Surge unlocks, Blunder deterioration and full Equipment Points; temporary elemental attributes do not alter primary physical/magic type.
